column1: # Reviewed glossary for localized LEGO search terms (consumed by enrich_lego_titles.py). One English word per line.
# Columns: en<TAB>de<TAB>fr<TAB>nl<TAB>it<TAB>es<TAB>pl . Several variants per cell are separated by "|"; an empty cell means
# "no translation / keep English". Keys are lowercase; a plural "s" is stripped as fallback. Fix a wrong term here and re-run
# `python3 -I enrich_lego_titles.py` - nothing else needs touching. Proper names (Star Wars, Ninjago, Harry Potter...) are not listed.
# Sections: "[words]" single words (must stay context-free-safe: no mapping that is wrong in another title context),
# "[phrases]" two-word phrases (checked in addition to single words), "[themes]" exact Rebrickable theme names
# (Duplo, City, Technic, ... stay English by omission).
